brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Former Anti-Corruption Official Among Two Iraqi Lawmakers Jailed for Illicit Enrichment. [2]
After more than two decades, U.S. forces prepare to leave Iraq. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR IRAQ
The jailing of lawmakers for illicit enrichment underscores governance challenges in a country with a Country Instability Index score of 64 of 100. [2][E1]
The departure of U.S. forces may affect security dynamics in a country where the most severe government travel advisory is Do Not Travel. [5][E2]

KEY RISKS
Iraq's link to 193 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations poses a financial risk to entities operating in the country. [E3]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market related to Iraq, "Will Iran target Iraq by September 30, 2026?", priced Yes at 59% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Sep 30, 2026. [E5]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the Polymarket question on whether Iran will target Iraq by September 30, 2026 is unresolved. [E5]
The impact of U.S. forces' departure from Iraq remains to be seen. [5]
